title: Audiogames.net experimental games
description:
This is a collection of 28 experimental titles created by university students, and originally hosted on audiogames.net. The games are in several different formats and programming languages all packaged together into one 7z archive. Most include some form of a manual or instructions, either alongside or as part of the game itself.

Note that many of these titles will require Adobe Flash to operate. We cannot provide support or help in getting them running on your system.
